title: Tech Note: Handling User Picture Inserts Into 4D Write Pro
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: WP INSERT PICTURE / WP Add picture
On Drop / On Before Keystroke / On After Edit form events

historical_commentary.text: 4D Write Pro remains 4D's current, actively developed word-processing engine (the successor to legacy 4D Write), so the picture model (background/in-line/anchored) and attribute-based API (WP SET ATTRIBUTES, WP INSERT PICTURE, WP Add picture) described here are still fully current; the drag/drop and paste handling techniques via On Drop and On Before Keystroke events are workaround-style solutions that remain necessary since 4D Write Pro still lacks a native 'on paste' event.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro is the modern, ongoing successor to classic 4D Write and continues to be actively enhanced; this note's API usage is current

No native 'On Paste' event has been added as of the note's writing; the On Before Keystroke workaround pattern shown here is still the documented approach unless a more direct paste event was added in a later release
